shared_elements: human figure(s) in profile with elaborate headdress
dense fields of pictographic/logographic signs in ordered blocks or rows
script arranged in columns/registers flanking or beneath a figural scene
justification: Both surfaces pair a profile human figure in an elaborate tall headdress with extensive fields of block-like script signs arranged in ordered columns and rows around/below the figural scene, a fairly specific documentary-monument scheme. But the depicted content differs strongly: A shows a single large, deeply modelled figure with a mask-like ornament and swirling plume filling the panel, while B shows a radiating sun disc with rayed hands over an offering table and multiple slender figures, with the vast majority of the field given to horizontal text lines; the sign forms and the rendering of bodies (blocky, ornament-encrusted vs. attenuated linear) follow quite different conventions.
